_note: Floor 3 of the Drambus Stack, and one sitting. `outside` is what makes it one: beating the boss puts you back in the field and a save taken inside reopens there too, so a floor is a thing you go in and finish or do not. Ten by ten, one thing at the end of it, and the next entry is a different map because the tower is a floor shorter. Which floor the door opens onto is derived from what has been answered rather than from a counter — the boss tiles are the record, and the order they come down in is the whole of the condition.

places.name: what is standing on floor 3
prose: The middle of it goes first and the rest follows it down, and for about a second there is a shape in the air where the storey was.

The buttress on the north face has closed its two-inch gap by half an inch. There is a card on the stone that says to tell somebody, and a name on it that was crossed out nine years ago. Two floors left.
